name: enviro-paper
description: End-to-end authoring skill for environmental-science field-sampling and monitoring papers — from raw sampling data to a submission-ready manuscript with reviewer-response letters. Covers QA/QC and non-detect handling, environmental statistics, pollution and risk indices (Igeo, EF, CF/PLI, Hakanson Er/RI, Nemerow, WQI, EPA HQ/HI/CR), publication figures, section-aware IMRaD writing and polishing, citation integrity (no fabricated DOIs), peer-review simulation, reviewer-response letters, and target-journal fit. Fuses the rigor of academic-research-skills (integrity gates, anti-fabrication) with the concrete outputs of nature-skills, tailored to environmental science.
